_comment: Maps queryable.json logical field names → physical parquet column names for STRING. HAND-MAINTAINED — do not overwrite with gen_schema.py --write.

protein_master_table_string._note: Conditional rename: if disk column is already 'protein_id' (canonical v2 parquet), this is a no-op. Applied via database_loader.py line 49.

protein_alias_string._note: Same conditional rename as protein_master_table_string. Applied via database_loader.py line 70.

ppi_association_string._note: partner_protein_size is injected by utils/partner_denorm.auto_add_partner_attributes(), then renamed to the table-prefixed name to avoid spurious FK cross-joins across the three PPI tables.

ppi_physical_string._note: Same partner_protein_size injection + table-prefixed rename as ppi_association_string.

ppi_detailed_channels_string._note: Same partner_protein_size injection + table-prefixed rename as ppi_association_string.

_structural_transforms._normalize_ppi_v2: All three PPI tables undergo bidirectional expansion: canonical undirected rows (A→B) are duplicated with protein_id↔protein_partner_id and gene_col↔partner_col swapped, so a single filter on the query-side gene column returns ALL partners. This is a row-duplication transform, not a column rename.
